At Journal Technologies , we believe our technology can be a force for good in the world ensuring the proper and efficient functioning of some of the most foundational aspects of society - the courts and justice system.

We create and implement enterprise software that supports the administration of justice, currently in the United States, Canada, and Australia.

While our eSeries product suite enables governments and their employees to deliver continued foundational court processes, our R&D focuses on leveraging emerging possibilities with technology to improve access and efficiency.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, Journal Technologies is a long-time, wholly-owned subsidiary of Daily Journal Corporation (NASDAQ: DJCO). We also have a major office in Logan, Utah, a team in Melbourne, Australia, an office in Victoria, Canada and a growing number of remote staff across North America.

Under our next generation of leadership, we're implementing a new vision for the company that prioritizes building an extraordinary workplace with empowered people at the heart of our business. Great people want to collaborate with great people, and we are actively looking for smart, motivated people who care deeply about the work they do.

Intermediate Business Development Representative Journal Technologies is seeking a driven and results-oriented Strategic Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our Customer Growth Team.

In this role, you'll partner with Account Executives to generate qualified pipeline, engage prospective customers, and support growth within the prosecutor market. We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and creating new opportunities.

The ideal candidate is proactive, accountable, and comfortable leveraging AI and modern productivity tools to improve outreach, research, and efficiency.

As a member of the Customer Growth Team, you'll also contribute beyond your day-to-day responsibilities by helping identify and execute strategic initiatives that drive business growth, improve the customer experience, and shape the future direction of the organization.

Whether it's streamlining internal processes, evaluating go-to-market strategies, or supporting cross-functional growth initiatives, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the business. What you'll do Generate qualified pipeline through outbound prospecting via phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and other digital channels.

Research target accounts, build prospect lists, and execute account-based outreach strategies. Qualify inbound and outbound leads and schedule meetings for the Account Executive team. Partner with Sales and Marketing to execute campaigns and customer engagement initiatives.

Leverage AI tools, automation, and emerging technologies to improve prospecting, outreach, and productivity. Continuously identify opportunities to improve messaging, outreach strategies, and pipeline growth.

As a member of the Customer Growth Team here at JTI, you will help shape initiatives that drive organizational growth, partnering across teams to improve processes, influence strategic priorities, and contribute to business outcomes beyond your individual sales responsibilities.

What Makes You Successful Self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. Results-driven with persistence and resilience. Adaptable and comfortable navigating changing priorities. Curious, collaborative, and eager to learn and improve. Able to work independently while contributing to a high-performing team.

What Success Looks Like Success in this role is measured by your ability to consistently generate qualified opportunities, build strong customer relationships, and contribute to pipeline growth. You'll be successful by: Executing consistent, high-quality outbound prospecting. Creating qualified meetings and sales opportunities.

Following through with prospects and internal partners. Collaborating effectively across the Customer Growth Team. Continuously improving through learning, experimentation, and technology. Qualifications & Skills Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Experience in business development, outbound sales, lead generation, or a customer-facing role. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Comfortable with outbound prospecting via phone, email, LinkedIn, and other digital channels.

Experience using AI productivity tools in a professional setting. Ability to work remotely with occasional travel for customer events, conferences, and team meetings. Experience working within Agile teams or formal training in Scrum or Agile methodologies is considered a strong asset.

Preferred Qualifications Experience with CRM and sales engagement platforms. Experience selling B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or public sector solutions. Familiarity with AI-powered sales tools, automation, or account-based selling strategies. The above statements describe the general nature and level of work being performed in this job function.

They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties; additional responsibilities may be assigned. At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are Canadian or U.S. citizens or permanent residents due to employment authorization requirements.

We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or work authorization support for this position. Why Journal Technologies ?

Visit www.journaltech.com/careers for more information, but highlights include: Competitive compensation* The salary range posted for this position reflects a good-faith estimate of the base salary we reasonably expect to offer a successful candidate upon hire.

Final compensation will be based on job-related factors, including qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal compensation considerations. Quality medical, dental and vision coverage. Competitive paid time off as well as paid holiday time. 401(k) retirement (US) and GRRSP (CDN) programs.

Annual professional development funds - $1,500 USD annual per employee. Book subscriptions with an extensive library in each office for personal and professional growth. Flexible working hours which you can coordinate with your supervisor. Ability for employees to work from a remote location (e.g., home) or office.

Personal meetings with direct managers approximately every four to six weeks to discuss career growth and advancement opportunities as well as other issues important to the employees. Travel opportunities between Journal Technology offices and with clients.

We provide technology that matters in the world, and we're a stable employer comprised of quality people, with a commitment to investing in our people. Originally posted on Himalayas

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal , you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.
This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal ’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal ’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $3.5M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

s.h: ## CE QUE TU PEUX FAIRE BOUGER ##
s.t:
En tant que Consultant en automatisation UiPath (tous genres), tu feras partie de notre équipe Agentic Automation Platform et travailleras à la conception, au développement et à l-amélioration continue de solutions d-automatisation modernes. Tu combines une expertise technique avec une compréhension des processus et des exigences de nos clients.
* **Conception & développement :** Tu conçois, développes et implémentes des solutions d-automatisation modernes avec UiPath et les accompagnes tout au long de leur cycle de vie.
* **Analyse des processus :** Tu analyses les processus métier et identifies, avec les clients et les départements concernés, les potentiels d-automatisation appropriés.
* **Automatisation :** Tu mets en œuvre des workflows robustes et maintenables avec UiPath Studio et Orchestrator et soutiens leur exploitation et leur évolution.
* **Conseil client :** Tu travailles en étroite collaboration avec les analystes métier, les clients et les interlocuteurs techniques et traduis les exigences métier en solutions techniques.
* **Normes :** Tu soutiens l-introduction et le développement continu des standards et des meilleures pratiques d-automatisation.
* **Responsabilité de projet :** Selon ton expérience, tu assumes de plus en plus de responsabilités dans les projets et évolues vers un niveau senior.
* **Travail d-équipe :** Tu t-impliques activement dans notre équipe et dans les échanges professionnels autour de l-automatisation métier.

* **Formation :** Tu as une formation achevée ou un diplôme dans le domaine de l-informatique, du génie logiciel ou dans une discipline comparable.
* **Expérience professionnelle :** Tu disposes d-une première à plusieurs années d-expérience dans le développement de solutions d-automatisation avec UiPath.
* **Connaissances UiPath :** Tu évolues au moins au niveau Professional Developer et peux développer et mettre en œuvre des solutions UiPath de manière autonome.
* **Certification :** Une certification UiPath Automation Developer Professional ou une qualification comparable est un avantage.
* **Compréhension des processus :** Tu as une bonne compréhension des processus métier et peux expliquer clairement les solutions techniques aux départements métier et aux clients.
* **Méthode de travail :** Tu travailles de manière structurée, orientée solution et autonome et souhaites te développer professionnellement et personnellement.
* **Compétence en IA :** Tu utilises les outils d-IA dans ton domaine avec assurance, évalues les résultats de manière critique et aides les clients et adessi à exploiter les potentiels de l-IA.
* **Compétences linguistiques :** Tu communiques très bien en allemand et en anglais ; l-allemand est indispensable pour nos projets clients.
* **Contact client :** Tu apprécies le contact avec les clients et la collaboration dans des équipes interdisciplinaires.
* **Disponibilité pour les déplacements :** Tu es prêt à te déplacer pour des projets en Suisse.
Idéalement, tu apportes également
* **BPM :** Expérience avec BPMN ou la gestion des processus métier
* **Portefeuille UiPath :** Expérience avec d-autres composants du portefeuille UiPath, par ex. Orchestrator, Apps ou AI Center

* **Conseil :** Première expérience en conseil technique ou en contact direct avec les clients

Peak Power is a North American cleantech company providing end-to-end battery energy storage solutions for large commercial, industrial, and manufacturing facilities operating in IESO, ISO-NE, PJM, and NYISO.

Through strategic investor partnerships, we remove capital cost barriers with zero-capex energy storage offered through a shared-savings model, aligning with customer success by prioritizing battery performance.

Auto Dealerships are dealing with the large problem of getting inventory because of the Pandemic and VETTX solves this problem for the auto dealerships.

s.h: HERE'S HOW THE SOFTWARE PLATFORM WORKS
s.t:
VETTX helps car dealerships acquire a steady stream of used car inventory without going to auctions or chasing down for-sale-by-owner leads.

Der eine HR-Entscheider greift am liebsten direkt zum Hörer, die nächste filtert ihre Prioritäten morgens per E-Mail, und wieder jemand anderes ist am besten über eine gezielte Nachricht auf LinkedIn erreichbar. Deine Kunst liegt darin, für die richtige Person den genau passenden Kanal zu wählen, echtes Interesse zu wecken und die Brücke zu bauen.
Deine Aufgaben
Identifikation und Marktanalyse: Du recherchierst eigenständig nach potenziellen Neukunden (B2B) und identifizierst die relevanten HR-Entscheider und Geschäftsführer in verschiedenen Zielmärkten. Du analysierst Branchen-Trends, um deine Ansprache maßzuschneidern.

Erstkontakt und Lead-Qualifizierung: Du sprichst potenzielle Kunden proaktiv über verschiedene Kanäle (Telefon, E-Mail, LinkedIn/Social Selling) an. Mit den richtigen Fragen findest du im Erstgespräch heraus, wo der Schuh drückt, und qualifizierst die Leads hinsichtlich ihres Bedarfs und Potenzials.
Beziehungsaufbau und Terminierung: Du begeisterst HR-Verantwortliche von unserer innovativen HR-Software und vereinbarst qualifizierte Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives. Du bist die „Visitenkarte“ von HRpuls und baust die erste vertrauensvolle Brücke zu unseren Kunden.
Pipeline-Management und Optimierung: Du pflegst unser CRM-System gewissenhaft und hältst deine Sales-Pipeline stets aktuell. Du optimierst deine Ansprache-Strategien kontinuierlich im Team, um die Effizienz und Conversion-Rate zu steigern.
Welche Qualifikation benötigst Du?
Vertriebsaffinität: Erste Erfahrung im Vertrieb, Telesales, Account Management oder der Kundenbetreuung – idealerweise im B2B- oder SaaS-Umfeld – ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Quereinsteiger mit der richtigen Einstellung sind herzlich willkommen!
Kommunikationsstärke: Du hast eine positive Ausstrahlung am Telefon, bist redegewandt, kannst aktiv zuhören und lässt dich von einem „Nein“ nicht entmutigen.
Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du organisierst deine Aufgaben und Leads selbstständig, arbeitest zielorientiert und behältst im CRM stets den Überblick.
Technische Affinität: Erfahrung mit modernen Software-Tools (z. B. Office, CRM-Systeme, SaaS) und ein Interesse an HR- und Softwarelösungen.
Lernbereitschaft: Du hast Lust, dich fachlich und methodisch im Tech-Vertrieb weiterzuentwickeln, und möchtest ein echter Experte in der Neukundenansprache werden.
Warum HRpuls?
Wachstum & Entwicklung: Unser kontinuierliches Wachstum bietet Dir die beste Grundlage für Deine persönliche, methodische und fachliche Entwicklung.
Weiterentwicklung: Bei uns hast Du die Chance, Deine Karriere aktiv zu gestalten.
Kreativer Freiraum: Wir lieben frische Ideen und setzen sie schnell um. Du wirst Teil eines Teams sein, das Innovation schätzt und ermutigt, Neues auszuprobieren. Fehler sind für uns kein Problem, sondern die Grundlage für Verbesserungen.
Team & Werte: Unser Team ist bunt und vielfältig, aber uns verbinden gemeinsame Werte, die auf unserer Website zu finden sind. Bei uns wirst Du Dich schnell als Teil einer starken Gemeinschaft fühlen.
Flexibel und ortsunabhängig: Als Remote-First-Unternehmen kannst Du vollständig ortsunabhängig arbeiten. Workations sind bei uns Standard. So gestaltest Du Deinen Arbeitsalltag flexibel, während Du gleichzeitig Teil unseres dynamischen Teams bleibst.

* Position MSC value proposition effectively versus competitors

* Drive booking conversion, upselling and overall commercial performance
* Contribute directly to individual sales and revenue targets
Client Portfolio Development
* Build and progressively develop a personal client portfolio
* Maintain customer relationships over time to encourage repeat bookings and long-term value
* Manage structured follow-ups, reactivation opportunities and future sales potential
* Work on both inbound customer requests and proactive outbound contacts from existing databases and commercial campaigns
Product Advisory
* Develop strong knowledge of MSC itineraries, ships, cabins, pricing logic and promotions
* Provide clear, reliable and personalized advice to customers
* Recommend tailored solutions while maintaining a premium customer experience
* Communicate the MSC value proposition effectively and credibly

* Previous experience in travel, hospitality or other service-oriented industries is a plus
* Experience in customer-facing environments such as retail, hotels, resorts, tourism, guest services, resort entertainment teams or similar roles involving direct interaction with customers will also be positively valued
What Matters Most
* Strong commercial mindset and natural focus on conversion and results
* Confidence in managing customer relationships and guiding decision-making
* Ability to follow up, advise and close with a structured and proactive approach
* Comfortable working in a performance-driven environment while maintaining a high-quality customer experience

* Consultative selling approach with a focus on revenue generation
* Good objection handling and ability to support customers in their decision process
